infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Wheelers uses your location to show nearby rides and ride requests, power trip navigation, and keep trip tracking accurate.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Wheelers uses your location in the background while you are online or on a trip so ride matching, live tracking, and safety tools keep working. Drivers who switch on Nearby ride alerts also share an approximate location while offline, so Wheelers can tell them about riders close by.
